edges.limits: GSE97362 explicitly forms one whole-blood source series in the multi-study detection-p-value/QC evaluation (table 145 male and 83 female assay records). It is not independent clinical replication of Kabuki effects; no donor or participant identity/linkage was established.

edges.evidence_location: Methods: epimutacionsData demonstration / data package; explicit three cases from GSE97362 and 48 controls from GSE104812

edges.evidence_location: Results: Table 1 Description of datasets; Results following Table 1: extracted methylation profiles; Nature Communications published version

decision.E0_T01: The same GSE97362 case series has historical technical and epimutation-tool reuse; explicit prior study reuse is not independent cohort linkage. E-Risk GSE154566 and GSE105018 were both used in the same 2024 paper but overlap remains unknown. Preserve person/specimen/family independence hold.
decision.E1_T07_T02: Rangani adds a narrow low-methylation/CpG-dependent measurement-bias comparator; not a 450K-to-EPIC rare-disease matched cohort, not new T07 code acceptance.
decision.E2_T02: No new molecularly confirmed case/independent-control evidence; do not promote published downstream examples to discovery cohorts.
decision.E3_T02: No new independent EPIC replication; planned held-out design unchanged.
decision.E4_T03: No specific new Sotos/Weaver/DNMT3A competing dataset edge qualified from overlap search.
decision.E5_T04: No generalisable new hierarchical competitor that displaces simple baselines.
decision.E6_T05: No new verified paired rare-disease methylation/expression donor linkage.
decision.E7_T05_T06: No new causal/functional perturbation evidence; still separately gated.
decision.novelty: Reused historical Kabuki cases and E-Risk cohorts are more extensively documented than previous 17-edge baseline; novelty must be a distinct clinical effect and independent validation, not untouched accession or generic toolkit.
decision.clinical_interpretation: Rangani's engineered HEK293T BACH2 assay context cannot establish clinical platform interchangeability; prior reviews reinforce that episignatures complement molecular diagnosis.
decision.scientific_priority: No resequencing: E0 admission > T07 accepted method > E2/E3; E1 stays optional.
decision.paper_bundling: Keep E1 method caveat as P1 supplement if material; no standalone paper inferred.
decision.journal: No change to provisional Molecular Syndromology / EJMG routing; OJRD remains conditional.
decision.rights: No changes; publisher article licences do not automatically relicense GEO sources.
decision.dependency: No newly verified MassDynamics-derived limma-core change/removal or other direct implementation release; no fork modification or numerical qualification.
